svg.aria-label: What I build. Running in production at a concrete and block plant. The plant ERP, front to back: 36 modules, 73 users, 27 roles, one codebase. A camera that counts blocks: it watches the line and logs output per chamber. Time clocks into payroll: shifts, sick leave, overtime and year-end pay. Quotes for precast beams: priced, revised and approved in one screen. A WhatsApp assistant: a local model answers from the plant data.
